sharedRules.name: Panzerfaust - Limited 1
sharedRules.description:
Each time this Unit shoots, one of its Teams my shoot as a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

Each time this Unit rolls To Hit in an assault, one of its Teams may attack with a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.

sharedRules.name: Flame-thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower and the Unit is automatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use their Top armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.

Flame-throwers my shoot in Defensive Fire. Howeverm while a Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, this does not automatically stop the assault, The defender still needs to score five (or eight) hits to sop the assault as normal.

sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: A Team's Armour rating is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away when hit by HEAT weapons.

sharedRules.name: Mounted Assault
sharedRules.description: This team has a bonus in Assaults and Counterattack when mounted with passengers.  Review 'MA' entries under Motivation and Skill.

sharedRules.name: Stormtroopers
sharedRules.description: A unit may attempt a second Movement Order after succeeding in its first Movement Order. The second Movement Order must be different from the first.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on the table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear.

sharedRules.name: Old Hand
sharedRules.description: An Old Hand Formation Commander gives Units from their Formation whose Unit Leader is within 6"/15cm a Tacticsrating of  3+.

sharedRules.name: Flame Tank
sharedRules.description: Flame Tanks cannot Charge into Contact and have an Assault rating of 5+.

sharedRules.name: Nest
sharedRules.description:
A Nest is always Concealed and in Bulletproof Cover. Teams Shooting a Nest must re-roll successful Firepower tests to Destroy it.
Nests cannot be Assaulted by Tanks nor can they Charge into Contact.
Each Nest is a separate Unit, even when taken as part of the same selection.
